jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Python Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**Your Team's Impact**

  

At FactSet, our Mergers & Acquisitions Data Solutions Engineering team is at the forefront of delivering high-quality, actionable M&A data to the world's leading financial professionals. We are responsible for building and maintaining the robust data pipelines, tools, and systems that power FactSet's M&A content covering deals, transactions, valuations, and market intelligence across global markets. If you are passionate about financial data, engineering innovation, and making an impact in the fintech space, this is the team for you. This team is responsible to build data pipeline and tools by leveraging Python, proprietary in-house libraries, and AWS technologies. Through automation and innovative solutions, we consistently improve productivity and operational efficiency across teams. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in implementing impactful solutions that deliver significant value to the organization.

  

Location: Hyderabad

Work Arrangement: Hybrid Setup

  
  

**What You'll Do**

FactSet is seeking a Python Developer, along with good problem-solving skills, to join our engineering team responsible for making our product more scalable and reliable.

* Deliver high-quality, reusable and maintainable code, perform Unit / Integration Testing of assigned tasks within the estimated timelines.
* Proactive in providing technical solutions with effective communication & collaboration skills.
* Perform Code Reviews and ensure best practices are followed.
* Work in an agile team environment and collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth product delivery.
* Ownership of end-end product & Individual contribution.
* Performance Improvements with the help of metrics provided by automatic monitoring of the product.
* Ensure high stability of the product.
* Continuous Knowledge sharing internal & external of the team.
* Collaborate with other engineers and Product Developers in a Scrum Agile environment using Jira and Confluence
Estimate task sizes and regularly communicate progress in daily standups and biweekly Scrum meetings  

  
  
  

**What We're Looking For**

Required

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science.
* 4-6 years of overall industry experience.
* 3-4 years of experience in Python.
* Strong experience and **proficiency with Python, Pandas, and FastAPI** .
* Strong experience with Javascript ES6+ , Typescript ,Vue 3,Pinia and Css3
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong experience with API design and Test Driven Development
* Experience with AWS cloud and CI / CD (Github Actions) , Redis and Pytest
* Relational database experience, preferably with POSTGRES, MSSQL.
* Experience with Github-based development processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Organized, self-directed, and resourceful with the ability to appropriately prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience building and deploying production-level services.
Nice to have with GenAI concepts like RAG ,AI integration ,MCP,Spec driven development and Agentic workflows / AI agents / agent orchestration.  

  
  

Desired Skills

* Work experience of Jupyter Notebooks.
* Infrastructure as code using Terraform.
* Familiar with Agile software development (Scrum is a plus).
Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment.  

  
  

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth, powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

  

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors, including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more a…

jobs.title: Senior Manager User Experience
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Role Overview:**

Optum's User Experience Design Team is looking for an energetic and creative Senior Manager who is passionate about the design of great health care experiences. As a Senior Manager you will report to the Senior Director of Product Design and supervise a team of senior designers. You will collaborate with researchers, developers and product managers to create best-in-class, interoperable and modern SaaS solutions using human-centered methodologies.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Manage a team of senior level product designers to design compelling and useful products
* Create functional prototypes, static mockups as well as textual specifications - each describing in as much detail and fidelity as possible the intended user-observable behavior of the final product
* Collaborate with stakeholders including UX Leads, Product Managers and Development Managers to identify, plan, prioritize and implement project design activities
* Participate in gathering research insights and concept testing to inform design decisions
* Perform design duties for one or more projects to meet UX, technical, and business needs
* Advocate for user-centered design including research and accessibility
* Leverage and contribute to existing design pattern libraries and interface guidelines
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of software engineering and technology or related filed
* 5+ years of UX design experience, including creating wireframes and prototypes to communicate design concepts
* 5 years of demonstrated understanding of mature user-centered design and research practices with a deep background and bias towards simplicity, elegance, and minimalism
* 5+ years of experience participating in user research and concept testing with real users
* 3+ years of proven ability to manage multiple user experience professionals towards a cohesive vision
* Portfolio of relevant user experience project deliverables
* Proven excellent communication skills, including the ability to present complex concepts clearly and persuasively across diverse audiences at various levels of our organization including executive leadership

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Information Architecture, Communications, Computer Science, or a related discipline
* Experience with enterprise software, B2B applications or large employee-facing systems in the medical, healthcare or financial domains
* Proven ability managing multiple projects simultaneously
* Knowledge of UX- related analytics, metrics, and measurement techniques
* Proven involvement in the UX community (e.g. associations, meet-ups, clubs, conferences)
* Proven collaborative, low-ego approach to working with others

**Soft Skills:**

* Verbal/Written Communication
* Active Listening
* Negotiation
* Empathy/Sensitivity
* Patience/Resilience
* Agility/Flexibility
* Conflict Resolution
* Cultural Sensitivity
* Effective time and resource management
* Disability & Diversity Awareness

**Technical Skills:**

* AI/ML and emerging technologies
* Resource Allocation
* Adaptability
* Multitasking with multiple platforms, tools, and applications
* Data Analysis
* Analytic/Troubleshooting

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - C# .net
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer – C# .net**

**Location: Hyderabad**

Are you a passionate developer with an agile mindset? And would you like to be part of a strategically important product area in one of the world’s leading software providers within the Fintech industry? Then you should join SimCorp as a C# & APL Software Engineer!

  

**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values – caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Transactions product area and contribute to business-critical functionality used by our clients in their daily investment operations.

You will work as part of an experienced engineering team, contributing to backend development, component design, performance, reliability and maintainability. The work is technically interesting because it combines complex business logic, long-lived enterprise software and the need to keep improving how we build and deliver functionality.

Most of the current product logic is written in APL, while we are increasing our use of C#/.NET in new development, integrations, cloud enablement, and platform modernization. You do not need prior APL experience. We will provide training and support and we are looking for someone who is curious enough to learn what is needed while bringing solid engineering practices from C#/.NET.

You will work with experienced engineers across locations and have room to contribute to how we build, modernize and evolve the product.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help the team build reliable, maintainable and well-tested backend solutions. In practice, you will:

* Design, implement, test and maintain backend functionality using APL and, where relevant, C#/.NET
* Contribute to component design, code quality, performance and long-term maintainability
* Work closely with product managers, engineers and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver client-relevant functionality
* Improve reliability and delivery through code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD and pragmatic engineering practices
* Investigate technical issues, performance bottlenecks and bugs and help design sustainable solutions
Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to technical discussions within the team  

**WHAT WE VALUE**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with C# and .NET technologies
* Solid experience with C#/.NET and backend development
* Good understanding of object-oriented design, clean code, APIs, and integration patterns
* Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and Git-based workflows
* Ability to work with complex business logic and collaborate with both technical and non-technical colleagues
* Interest in learning APL. Prior APL experience is not required
Experience with Azure or cloud-based development is an advantage, but not a prerequisite  

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Experience from fintech, financial services or another regulated industry
* Exposure to functional, array-oriented or vector-based programming languages
* Experience with Azure services or cloud-based development
Experience mentoring other engineers or taking ownership of a component  

**BENEFITS**

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

  

**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Viswanath Tangella (viswanath.tangella@simcorp.com), Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

  

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

  

**WHO WE ARE?**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with large and global investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment mana…

jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description:
**About Reputation**

Reputation, founded in Silicon Valley in 2013, is the industry's sole platform that uses an AI-powered product stack to help companies measure, manage, and scale their real-time reputation performance everywhere, effectively functioning as a business's eyes and ears across all customer feedback channels to uncover predictive insights. This market leadership is reinforced by significant funding from top-tier firms like Bessemer Venture Partner, Kleiner Perkins, and Marlin Equity Partners, driving substantial annual recurring revenue from Global Fortune 1000 companies, major automotive OEMs, healthcare systems, and top property management firms, with trust from over 250 partners including Google and Meta. Recognized recently as America’s Greatest Midsized Workplaces by Newsweek which rewards excellence and career development, and attracts player-coaches, team-oriented collaborators, and individuals who value perseverance and hustle.

**Your Role at Reputation:**

We’re looking for a talented and passionate UX/Product Designer who thrives on tackling complex problems and crafting seamless, elegant user experiences. User experience is at the forefront of how we design intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. This role will focus on contributing to the design and expansion of our product platform, collaborating cross-functionally, and delivering impactful solutions. You will have the opportunity to work closely with customers and internal teams to see your designs come to life and make a meaningful impact for our customers and their businesses.

**How You’ll Shape the Experience:**

* Collaborate early with cross-functional teams including product management, engineering, customer success, and implementation/managed services to ensure UX design integration into the product lifecycle is technically feasible and meets design standards.
* Work closely with other UX team members and leadership to provide consistent experiences while simplifying complex user flows.
* Understanding of WCAG 2.2 accessibility requirements for web and mobile.
* Conduct user research with internal teams and customers, analyze feedback, and translate insights into actionable design solutions.
* Create wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs for adaptive web and mobile platforms.
* Support the development and maintenance of the design system to ensure consistency across products and functions.
* Advocate for user-centered design principles and contribute to usability testing and iteration cycles.
* Partner with product managers and developers to ensure accurate implementation of design specifications.
* Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices to bring innovative ideas to the UX Team.

**The Skills That Set You Apart:**

* Bachelor’s degree in UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Graphic Design, or a related field or 3-4 years of equivalent design experience.
* Understanding of the application of AI tools in design processes (i.e., skills, agentic AI, generative AI, Figma Agents, etc.)
* Understanding of software development life cycles
* 2+ years of experience in UX design for enterprise web and mobile applications, SaaS, and B2C or B2B
* Some experience designing for data analytics and data visualization.
* Strong interaction design skills and a solid understanding of user-centered design principles and patterns.
* Experience in conducting and analyzing user research.
* Understanding of Design Thinking processes and their implementation into engineering and product priorities.
* Proficiency in design/prototyping tools like Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
* Experience designing for responsive web applications and mobile/tablet platforms.
* Excellent analytical skills.
* Ability to communicate design concepts effectively across different audiences.
* A collaborative spirit in working with product/engineering teams as well as other designers.
* Experience working within agile development teams.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, creative, and eager to collaborate in a team environment.

**Where You’ll Connect & Collaborate:**

* Your main HQ is our Hyderabad, Telangana office, but we know great work can happen anywhere. You’ll have the flexibility of a hybrid schedule, joining us in person on Tuesdays and Wednesdays (subject to change) and working from home the rest of the week.

**Our Benefits & Perks**

We believe our people deserve to feel supported, valued, and rewarded both in and out of work. That’s why we offer a generous and thoughtfully designed benefits package, including:

* **Health Insurance & Wellness Benefits:** Group Health Insurance: Medical Insurance with floater policy of up to Rs 10,00,000 for employee + spouse + 2 dependent children + 2 parents / parent-in-laws
* **Maternity Benefits:** Medical insurance up to 75,000 INR, 26 weeks of leave for birth, adoption or surrogacy
* **Life Insurance:** Insurance at 3x annual cost to the company (Term Insurance, GPA)
* **Accident/Disability Insurance:** Insured at 3x base salary for permanent total disability, permanent partial disability and temporary total disability (GPA)
* **OPD:** As part of your health benefits, Employees are entitled to an annual OPD allowance of ₹7,500. This can be used for doctor consultations, diagnostic tests, and prescribed medications. The benefit is applicable to both the employee and eligible dependents and should be claimed within a month's time.
* **AHC:** All employees are eligible for one complimentary Annual Health Check each year. Employees may also extend this benefit to their dependents, they can avail the same package at the specially negotiated rates, payable by the employee.

**Leaves**

* **Company Holidays:** 10 paid holidays per year (see annual Holiday Calendar)
* **Casual/Sick Leave:** 12 days per year (pro-rated)
* **Earned Leave:** 2 days per month (pro-rated)
* **Extended Company Holidays:** 4 additional paid days off

jobs.title: BI Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an experienced **Business Intelligence Team Manager** to lead our BI team within Capital Markets Data Solutions.

The role is responsible for delivering trusted, scalable and intuitive analytics for **internal stakeholders and external clients** , with a particular focus on **Equities and Foreign Exchange Trading** .

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring deep expertise in **Tableau and data visualisation** , combined with strong knowledge of **Snowflake, AWS, Data Engineering and Capital Markets** . The successful candidate will lead the team, shape the technology roadmap and ensure our BI capability delivers measurable business and client outcomes.

We are looking for a forward-thinking leader who continually challenges how technology, data and ways of working can be **faster, simpler, more secure, resilient and cost-effective** .

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead, coach and develop a high-performing BI team.
* Own BI delivery and partner with Product, Data Engineering, Technology, internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Provide technical leadership across **Tableau Products (Tableau Cloud, Tableau Server and Tableau Desktop)** , including visualisation, architecture, performance, administration, authentication, security and deployment.
* Apply strong **Equities Trading and FX knowledge** to turn complex market, liquidity and execution data into actionable insights.
* Work with Data Engineering teams to optimise **data models, pipelines and queries for speed, scalability and user experience** .
* Influence the end-to-end architecture across **Snowflake, AWS, Tableau and the wider data ecosystem** .
* Ensure strong **cyber security, data quality, governance, controls and entitlements** across BI solutions.
* Establish reliable **operational support, monitoring, incident management, resilience and recovery frameworks** for critical BI services.
* Champion governed self-service analytics and continuously improve the client and user experience.
* Lead Tableau adoption and the **Tableau Centre of Excellence** by establishing governance, standards, training, and best practices, enabling secure self-service analytics and driving user adoption.
* Manage relevant **technology contracts, licensing, suppliers and renewals** , with a focus on commercial and cost optimisation.
* Continually evaluate new **BI, cloud, data and AI technologies** , driving automation, simplification and modernisation.

  

**Skills & Experience**
-----------------------

### **Essential**

* Significant BI and data visualisation experience, including **leadership of technical teams** .
* Strong knowledge of **Equities and Foreign Exchange Trading markets** , including trading, liquidity and execution data.
* **Deep Tableau expertise** , including advanced visualisation, UI/UX, performance optimisation, administration and enterprise deployment.
* Strong experience with **Snowflake and AWS** in enterprise data and analytics environments.
* Advanced SQL and strong understanding of **data warehousing, dimensional modelling and data engineering** .
* Experience optimising the end-to-end journey from **data engineering through to visualisation and user experience** .
* Strong understanding of **cyber security, data governance, controls, lineage and access management** .
* Experience establishing and managing reliable **production and operational support frameworks** .
* Strong stakeholder and client management skills, including experience working with **external clients** .
* Experience managing **technology contracts, licensing, suppliers and renewals** .
* Strong commercial awareness and a continuous improvement mindset.
* **Demonstrable experience delivering measurable business outcomes** through data and BI, including improved decision-making, client experience, efficiency, revenue, risk reduction or cost optimisation.

### **Desirable**

* Python
* CI/CD and BI deployment automation
* Experience modernising legacy BI estates
Exposure to AI-enabled analytics and emerging data technologies  

  

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Success means building a BI capability that is **high-performing, client-focused, secure, reliable and continuously improving** .

The successful candidate will develop a strong Hyderabad team, improve the performance and user experience of our analytics, strengthen operational resilience and controls, and ensure our investment in **Tableau, Snowflake and AWS translates into measurable value for Equities, FX, internal stakeholders and external clients** .

**This role is ultimately accountable for turning trusted Capital Markets data into fast, intuitive and actionable insights that deliver meaningful business and client outcomes.**

  

**Our people**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

jobs.title: Group Marketing Manager/ Digital Marketing
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven **Group Marketing Manager** to lead and manage the marketing activities of the Group across **India and Dubai**.

The role will have a strong focus on **digital marketing, lead generation, content creation, SEO, website management, social media, paid campaigns, brand development and marketing analytics**, along with managing events and other marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate should be hands-on, commercially focused and capable of taking ownership of marketing activities from **strategy and planning through execution and performance analysis**.**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Develop and execute the Group's digital marketing strategy across India and Dubai.
* Plan and manage **Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and other relevant digital campaigns**.
* Develop lead-generation campaigns for products and services.
* Manage campaign budgets, targeting, creatives and landing pages.
* Monitor CPL, conversion rates, lead quality, ROI and overall campaign performance.
* Work closely with the Sales and Business Development teams to improve lead conversion.
* Build and continuously optimize digital marketing funnels.

**2. Content Creation & Brand Communication**

* Develop and execute the Group's content strategy across digital platforms.
* Create and manage content for **LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, website, email campaigns and other relevant channels**.

**3. SEO & Website Management**

* Own the Group's website performance and ensure content is regularly updated.
* Develop and implement **SEO strategies** to improve organic visibility and rankings.
* Conduct keyword research, on-page and off-page SEO and competitor analysis.
* Work with agencies/developers where required for website improvements.
* Monitor website traffic, enquiries, conversions, bounce rates and other key metrics.
* Develop landing pages for campaigns and lead-generation activities.

**4. Social Media Management**

* Develop the Group's social media strategy and content calendar.
* Manage social media campaigns and organic growth initiatives.

**Overview**

The Windows + Devices Fundamentals team builds and operates data platforms and backend services that help teams improve Windows performance, power efficiency, and reliability. We connect signals from labs and the installed base to trustworthy metrics, actionable diagnostics, and measurable improvements in responsiveness, battery life, memory efficiency, and device health.

We are looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own a data and services product area that turns these signals into effective engineering workflows. You will define product and measurement strategy, set priorities across related capabilities, and partner with engineering and data science from customer discovery through delivery and adoption. This is a hands-on technical PM role: you should be comfortable querying data, reasoning about service behavior, and connecting platform investments to better customer experiences.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Product direction: Own the strategy and roadmap for a data and services product area. Understand engineering teams' needs and prioritize reusable capabilities that address common problems, rather than one-off reports.
* Data products: Define requirements across telemetry ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, and APIs. Partner on schema evolution, data quality, freshness, privacy, and access control so downstream consumers can trust and use the data.
* Measurement and analysis: Establish metric definitions, baselines, and cohorts across devices, silicon, and customer segments. Use SQL/KQL and statistical reasoning to investigate metric movements, distinguish regressions from measurement changes, and guide investments.

* Automation and adoption: Prioritize self-service diagnostics, alerting, and validated AI-assisted analysis that help teams detect issues earlier and reduce manual investigation. Measure adoption, diagnostic effectiveness, time saved, and impact on Windows fundamentals.
* Technical leadership: Communicate complex findings and tradeoffs clearly. Strengthen product thinking through knowledge sharing, mentorship, and inclusive collaboration.

**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.

**Additional or preferred qualifications**

**Other Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in product management, program management, software engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role.
* Experience leading a data platform, analytics product, or cloud service initiative from problem definition through delivery and adoption in partnership with engineering.
* Hands-on experience using SQL, Kusto Query Language (KQL), or equivalent tools to investigate large datasets, assess measurement quality, and guide product decisions.
* Ability to reason about data pipelines, APIs, service dependencies, and operational tradeoffs, and translate customer needs into clear requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Working knowledge of system performance, power efficiency, or reliability, and the ability to connect technical metrics to customer experience.
* Experience with lab or deployed-device telemetry, cohort design, experimentation, anomaly detection, or data-quality systems.
* Experience with Windows, operating systems, devices, or hardware-software interactions that affect performance, power, and reliability.
* Familiarity with Kusto, Azure or comparable data platforms, and production service operations, including monitoring, incident learning, service-level objectives, and cost optimization.
* Demonstrated ability to align multiple teams and turn ambiguous technical problems into a sequenced roadmap with measurable results.
* Experience addressing privacy, security, access control, and retention requirements in data products.
* Experience evaluating automation or AI-assisted analysis for engineering workflows, including accuracy, usefulness, and adoption.

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.
  
  
Our 1,300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products - ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.
  
  
For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com
  
  
JAGGAER is an AI-powered procure to pay and source to pay software solutions platform for manufacturing, public sector and higher education.

Product Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director of Product Management, JAI
  
  
**Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**About The Role**
This role owns JAGGAER's analytics and data products: the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the next generation of data products we build for customers. These are established, revenue-generating capabilities with live commitments across the customer base, and they are being reshaped by AI faster than any other part of the platform.
  
  
The mandate is to define and deliver what those products become in an AI-first platform. That means insight that finds the customer rather than waiting to be asked for, including generated insight and anomaly detection across their spend. It means data products built for a customer's own systems and agents to consume, not only for a person to read. And it means owning the trust layer underneath all of it, so that the answers our AI produces are accurate enough to put in front of a procurement executive.

* Strong working understanding of data platforms, semantic and dimensional modelling, and analytics or BI tooling. Snowflake experience is an advantage.

jobs.description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.
  
  
On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.
  
  
On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.
  
  
Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query.
  
  
**Who You Will Work With**
You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.
  
  
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products.
* Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking.
* Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance.
* Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations.
* Experience with data pipelines and connectors on cloud object storage, including batch and incremental or streaming ingestion.
* Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise and developer adoption, including open ecosystems such as Python, Jupyter, and agent frameworks.
* Familiarity with the competitive landscape, such as Pinecone, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, pgvector, Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, and the ability to benchmark against it.
* Excellent communication skills, with a strong track record of customer engagement, product KPIs, and prioritization.
* Experience with AI productivity tools, and the ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes in fast-paced environments.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost.
* Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data.
* A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches.
* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval.
* Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
* Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces.
* Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. PepsiCo Digital Product team, as part of Strategy & Transformation, provides end-to-end products and solutions that focus on having the right data and insights, accessible for the right people, driving their business goals at the right time, across the globe. These products enable a unique competitive advantage to delight both our customers and consumers and create a catalyst for a PepsiCo data-driven culture. The Product Management team will lead the creation of the next generation of infrastructure, data science insights, and business applications that drive business value across global teams. We will achieve this by delivering a vision and strategic roadmap for best-in-class platforms, and consistently executing against key milestones in direct collaboration with global engineering and data science teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support product strategy and direction; define and prioritize product requirements, features and functionality across portfolio with product managers
* Support key stakeholders, business engagement, and product managers to socialize product plans and requirements, research, brainstorm and validate new functionality, and address any product issues
* Support the technical vision alongside engineering team and executive management, influence, and lead cross-functional teams on strategic product direction
* Support driving the lifecycle of all products, from inception and build to commercialization and adoption, ensuring the continuous improvement of products
* Support the vision, interpret global business needs, ultimately drive implementation.
* Demonstrate passion for excellence related to product design, delivery, and engineering
* Work collaboratively with regional and global partners

**Product Strategy and Roadmap:**

* Develop a comprehensive product strategy and roadmap
* Identify key metrics and performance indicators to measure the success and effectiveness of the digital application.

**User Research and Requirements Gathering:**

* Partner with our Service Design team to engage with users to understand their preferences, pain points, and expectations regarding brand loyalty programs.
* Translate user needs and requirements into clear product specifications and user stories.

**Feature Definition and Prioritization:**

* Collaborate with design and development teams to define and prioritize features that enhance the product experience
* Work closely with stakeholders to manage expectations and align feature prioritization with business objectives.

**Agile Development and Project Management:**

* Utilize Agile methodologies to drive the product development process, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint reviews.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient execution of the product roadmap and timely delivery of features.
* Monitor project timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure successful project completion.

**User Experience and Engagement:**

* Conduct usability tests, A/B testing, and other user feedback mechanisms to continuously improve the app's user experience.

**Data Analysis and Optimization:**

* Utilize analytics tools to monitor user behavior, engagement, and conversion rates among users.
* Use data-driven insights to make informed decisions regarding feature updates, user flows, and overall app performance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Bachelor’s degree in quantitative or engineering related field preferred; Master’s degree preferred
* 10+ years of product management focused on enterprise or supply chain with experience creating strategic product roadmaps and working with cross-functional teams in a highly-matrixed environment
* Experience building and launching products from ideation through launch and revision.

**Skills, Abilities, Knowledge:**

* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, along with the ability to influence and demonstrate confidence in communications with senior level management
* Proven track record of overseeing a portfolio of multiple projects
* Positive and flexible attitude to enable adjusting to different needs in an ever-changing environment
* Strong knowledge and experience in agile methodologies, experience working with multiple scrum teams on simultaneous builds
* Proactively drives impact and engagement while bringing others along
* Ability to lead others without direct authority

LiveRamp is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with offices worldwide. Learn more at LiveRamp.com.
  
  
LiveRamp, Inc. is seeking a talented and motivated Product Manager to join our dynamic team. * Competitive salary and performance-based incentives

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
  
  
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few.
  
  
Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site (experian.com/careers) to understand why.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role will be central to advancing Experian's next-generation fraud platform capabilities, focused on delivering a modular, platform-native, and extensible Digital Intelligence ecosystem that powers device intelligence, behavioral analytics, and behavioral biometrics across the customer lifecycle—from onboarding to authentication and account management.
  
  

* The Senior Product Manager will lead initiatives that strengthen Experian's Ascend Fraud Platform by enhancing device identification, cross-environment recognition, ML-driven intelligence, and proprietary risk signals, while reducing reliance on third-party vendors and improving customer outcomes.
* This role reports to the Director of Product Management and works closely with global and regional product teams, engineering, data science, and go-to-market stakeholders to execute high-impact product initiatives from concept through launch and scale.
* This is an ideal opportunity for a Product Manager with strong domain expertise in Device Intelligence, Fraud Detection & Prevention, and platform products, who can translate complex business and technical requirements into scalable solutions that drive revenue protection, cost efficiency, and competitive differentiation.

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Define and execute the strategy for Unified Digital Intelligence, aligning with Experian's broader fraud platform vision and Ascend ecosystem
* Drive evolution from legacy systems toward a platform-native, microservices-based device intelligence architecture
* Deliver a roadmap that strengthens Experian's market position against competitors

**Market Research & Competitive Intelligence**

* Analyze industry trends across device intelligence, behavioral analytics, and fraud prevention ecosystems
* Identify opportunities to expand capabilities in behavioral biometrics, AI-driven fraud detection, and cross-channel intelligence
* Continuously evaluate build vs. buy decisions to reduce vendor dependency and unlock strategic advantage

**Product Discovery & Customer Insights**

* Engage with customers, partners, and regional teams to identify key pain points across fraud use cases
* Translate insights into actionable product requirements that improve fraud detection accuracy and reduce customer friction
* Validate opportunities that accelerate client adoption and integration velocity

**Data-Driven Product Management**

* Use quantitative and qualitative data to optimize fraud detection performance and signal quality, reduce false positives and customer friction, prioritize features and investments

**Go-To-Market & Adoption**

* Partner with GTM, sales, and customer success teams to enable successful launches and feature adoption
* Accelerate onboarding via simplified integration (e.g., hosted collectors, SDKs)

**Qualifications**

* You are required to have 11+ years of Product Management experience in complex, matrixed organizations
* Strong domain expertise in Fraud, Risk, Device Intelligence, or Identity solutions
* 5+ years of experience building platform products, APIs, microservices, and SDK-based solutions
* Proven track record of delivering products that drive revenue impact, cost savings, or scalability improvements
* Experience working with AI/ML-driven products, including model lifecycle and data-driven decision-making
* Familiarity with device fingerprinting, behavioral analytics, or fraud signal ecosystems

**Additional Information**
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, collaboration, wellness, reward & recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's people first approach is award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2024 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, and Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2024 to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site and Glassdoor to understand why.

**Product Manager**

  .

* **8–10 years**
  of experience across Product and Engineering.

  **Software Engineering, QA, DevOps, SRE or Platform Engineering**
  .

Leverage Edu is an AI-powered talent mobility platform helping students achieve their global education and career aspirations. Through technology, innovation, and data-driven solutions, we are transforming the study abroad journey for students across the globe.

  

**About the Role:**  
 We are looking for a highly driven Product Manager to own end-to-end product development across both customer-facing and internal business platforms. As an Individual Contributor (IC), you will build new products, scale existing ones, and continuously improve user experiences while driving measurable business impact.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the complete product lifecycle, from ideation and roadmap planning to launch, adoption, and continuous optimization.
* Lead products through every growth stage (0 to 1, 1 to 10, and 10 to 100) by building new solutions and enhancing existing capabilities.
* Own both customer-facing and internal business products, improving user experience and operational efficiency.
* Define product vision, prioritize initiatives, and maintain a roadmap aligned with customer needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Leadership to deliver high-quality product initiatives.
* Use analytics, customer insights, experimentation, and market research to validate ideas and prioritize features.
* Identify opportunities to automate workflows and leverage AI to improve customer experience and business productivity.
* Track key product metrics and user feedback to improve adoption, engagement, and customer satisfaction.

  

**What You Bring:**

  

* Strong product thinking: the ability to identify customer and business problems, prioritize effectively, and turn ideas into impactful solutions.
* Proven experience building and scaling products across different growth stages with measurable business outcomes.
* Analytical mindset: comfortable using data, experimentation, and customer insights to make decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across Engineering, Design, Business, and Leadership.
* Ownership mindset: a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and drives initiatives to completion.

  

**What We Offer:**

  

* High ownership of products that directly influence customer experience and business growth.
* Close work with founders and senior leadership on strategic, high-impact initiatives.
* Opportunity to build products used by thousands of students and internal stakeholders across multiple geographies.

jobs.description:
**Role Summary**

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end lifecycle of the investment products portfolio, covering Mutual Funds, PMS/AIF, Market Linked Debentures (MLDs), Unlisted Products and other third-party distribution products. The role covers product onboarding, business growth, training of the sales and relationship teams, and regulatory and internal compliance across the portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Onboarding & Partner Management**

* Identify, evaluate and onboard AMCs, PMS/AIF managers, MLD issuers and unlisted product providers.
* Conduct product and partner due diligence, including track record, risk profile, fee structure and documentation.
* Negotiate commercial terms and manage empanelment, agreements and renewals.
* Coordinate with Operations, Technology and Legal for system set-up, product mapping and go-live.

**2. Product Growth & Business Performance**

* Drive AUM, revenue and client penetration targets for each product category.
* Develop product positioning, sales pitches, collateral and campaigns in coordination with Marketing.
* Track business MIS, product performance and pipeline, and present insights and recommendations to the Product Head.
* Work with sales and relationship teams to resolve bottlenecks and improve conversion.

**3. Training & Team Enablement**

* Design and deliver regular product, process and regulatory training for RMs, dealers and sales teams.
* Keep the teams updated on new launches, product changes, market developments and regulatory updates.
* Support teams with client-facing queries and structured product discussions.
* Track training coverage and the certification status of the relevant teams.

**4. Compliance & Risk Governance**

* Ensure all products and processes comply with SEBI, AMFI, exchange and other applicable regulations and internal policies.
* Maintain adherence on suitability, risk profiling, disclosures, advertising and marketing guidelines, and the execution-only versus advisory distinction.
* Ensure statutory and internal certification requirements (such as NISM/AMFI) are met for staff involved in distribution.
* Support internal audits, regulatory inspections and compliance reviews, including preparing responses and closing observations on time.
* Review product literature, communications and client documentation with Compliance before release.
* Monitor complaints and escalations related to products and drive corrective action.

**5. Process & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work with Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Customer Service to improve product processes and client experience.
* Contribute to the product roadmap, new product evaluation and process improvements.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Economics or a related field. MBA/PGDM (Finance) or CA/CFA preferred.
* 6 to 10 years of experience in wealth management, broking or distribution of investment products, with at least 3 years in a product or product-management role.
* Working knowledge of Mutual Funds, PMS/AIF, MLDs and Unlisted Products, including structures, taxation and risk characteristics.
* Sound understanding of SEBI and AMFI regulations applicable to distribution.
* Valid NISM Series V-A certification; other relevant NISM certifications preferred.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical, commercial and negotiation skills
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to train and influence large teams
* Strong compliance orientation and attention to detail
* Stakeholder management across business, operations and compliance functions
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint, and comfort with MIS and data-driven decision making
* Ownership mindset and the ability to work independently under deadlines

jobs.description:
* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  
  
This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  
  
You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co-located, and there isn't always a well-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  
  
Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end-to-end technology programs — translate high-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non-co-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in a high-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**  
  
**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

jobs.description:
**Role Summary & Role Description**

The role is responsible for building, validating, maintaining, and governing end‑to‑end service maps within the CMDB to ensure accurate visibility of business services and their underlying application and infrastructure dependencies. The role supports operational resilience, regulatory compliance (including DORA), incident and change impact analysis, and ongoing BAU governance by ensuring service maps meet defined quality, completeness, and freshness standards.

This role works closely with Application Owners, SMEs, Discovery teams, ServiceNow Operations, and Governance stakeholders to ensure service mapping data is accurate, auditable, and fit for operational and regulatory use cases.

  
  

**Service Mapping & CMDB Management**

* Create, enhance, and maintain business service and application service maps using ServiceNow Service Mapping and Discovery capabilities.
* Validate relationships between business services, applications, and underlying configuration items (servers, databases, load balancers, networks, cloud resources).
* Ensure service maps follow approved mapping standards, rubrics, and SOPs.
* Build, maintain, and optimize service maps using a combination of pattern based (top-down) and automated discovery techniques (e.g. Tag based), starting from defined application entry points (URL, IP, load balancer) and leveraging ML assisted, traffic based dependency detection to automatically identify, validate, and maintain accurate end to end service relationships across applications and infrastructure.
* Identify and remediate gaps such as missing relationships, incorrect dependency paths, stale or orphaned CIs.
* Coordinate with Discovery and Infrastructure teams to resolve discovery gaps, CI inaccuracies, and integration issues.
* Perform map validation sessions with Application Owners and SMEs to confirm technical and business accuracy.
* Support iterative refinement cycles and health reviews of service maps.
* Monitor data freshness, CI health, and mapping quality metrics.
  

  

**Governance, BAU, Compliance & Automation**

* Support BAU service mapping governance, including tier based recertification cycles and evidence collection.
* Track exceptions, remediation actions, and stakeholder responses related to service map validation.
* Maintain audit ready documentation and evidence to support regulatory and internal control requirements (e.g., DORA).
* Contribute to KPI reporting, dashboards, and management updates on mapping coverage and quality.
* Contribute to ITAM automation by identifying repeatable asset management tasks and supporting automation enhancements that improve data accuracy, lifecycle visibility, and operational efficiency across the asset estate.
* Collaborate cross functionally to identify, prioritize, and deliver automation enhancements, ensuring solutions are scalable, platform aligned, and support BAU efficiency, governance, and audit readiness.
  

  

**Core/Must have skills**

Strong understanding of Service Mapping concepts, CMDB, and dependency mapping.

Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow (Service Mapping, Discovery, CMDB).

Experience with tag-based service mapping and meta data driven mapping approaches, particularly in cloud environments.

Understanding of IT infrastructure components (servers, databases, networks, cloud services).

Familiarity with ITSM processes (Incident, Change, Problem).

  
  

**Good to have skills**

ServiceNow Certification (CSA, CIS.SM)

Familiarity with improving mapping outcomes through pattern optimization or extension concepts (where applicable)

Understanding of MID Server setup, health monitoring, and discovery troubleshooting.

Hybrid

Service mapping, CMDB, ServiceNow Discovery

* Experience in QA methodology and tools

This is a builder’s role for someone who can work closely with Engineering to translate complex tax workflows into scalable technology solutions—from requirements definition through production delivery.
  
  
We are looking for someone who has personally built and shipped technology solutions for hedge fund tax operations. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience taking products or platform capabilities from concept and requirements through design, development, testing, and production, working closely with engineering teams throughout the process.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of tax domain expertise, product thinking, and technology execution. You should be comfortable understanding complex hedge fund tax workflows, identifying opportunities to solve them through technology, defining clear product requirements, and partnering hands-on with Engineering to deliver solutions that are scalable, reliable, and user focused.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the product: Drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery for the Tax Product roadmap, working directly with engineering through the full lifecycle from problem definition to production.

**What You'll Need**

* 8–12 years of experience in US Taxation, with hands-on domain expertise in US Tax Compliance and Planning for Hedge Funds.
* Working knowledge of wash sales, tax lot classification (including Section 1256 treatment), K-1 and investor allocation processing, and regulatory filings such as FBAR, FATCA, and FIN48.
* Direct, verifiable experience building or delivering technology solutions for tax operations like platform features, workflow automation, or systems you helped design and ship with an engineering team.
* Ability to work independently and produce accurate output that holds up on subsequent reviews.
* Strong communication skills, with a track record of meeting client and internal commitments on time.
* An outstanding academic background and genuine interest in working in a high-tech software development environment.

jobs.description:
### Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Product Owner to join our product organization in Chennai. This role will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, UX, Quality, Security, and other Product Owners to translate product strategy and customer needs into clear, actionable priorities for engineering teams.

The Product Owner will be responsible for defining and prioritizing the team backlog, providing clarity on customer and business outcomes, supporting product discovery, and enabling the delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality solutions.

We are looking for a Product Owner who goes beyond backlog management and understands the customer problem, business value, product context, and technical considerations required to make effective product decisions.

Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid)

### Responsibilities

#### Product Ownership and Delivery

* Translate product strategy, customer needs, and business priorities into well-defined features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Own, prioritize, and continuously refine the team backlog in alignment with Product Management priorities.
* Ensure the engineering team understands the customer problem, expected outcome, and value behind the work.
* Make timely product decisions and provide clarification throughout the development lifecycle.
* Review delivered capabilities against agreed requirements, acceptance criteria, and intended customer outcomes.
* Balance new capabilities with technical enablers, quality improvements, security requirements, and technical debt.

#### Product Discovery and Collaboration

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, UX, and other stakeholders to understand and validate customer problems.
* Support product discovery through customer feedback, technical investigations, prototypes, and incremental validation.
* Collaborate with other Product Owners to manage dependencies and ensure alignment across teams.
* Understand technical constraints and trade-offs sufficiently to support effective prioritization and product decisions.
* Identify dependencies, risks, edge cases, and operational considerations early in the development process.

#### Agile Planning and Execution

* Participate in roadmap refinement, PI Planning, iteration planning, backlog refinement, demos, retrospectives, and Inspect & Adapt activities where applicable.
* Ensure features and stories are sufficiently prepared ahead of planning and development.
* Coordinate priorities and dependencies across teams.
* Track progress toward product outcomes and adjust priorities based on customer feedback, business needs, and delivery learnings.

### Technical Requirements

The Product Owner is not expected to define engineering implementation but should have sufficient technical understanding to engage effectively with engineers and architects.

Experience or working knowledge in several of the following areas is preferred:

* Cloud-based platforms
* Mobile applications and ecosystems
