jobs.description:
**Job Title: Product Manager / Product Owner Billing & Revenue Cycle**

  

**Location: India**

  

**About the Company**

  

First Insight is a leading healthcare technology company headquartered in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, USA. With more than 30 years of innovation and industry leadership, First Insight serves over 2,000 eye care professionals nationwide through a fully integrated technology platform.

In 1994, First Insight became the first company to introduce a fully integrated EHR, Practice Management, and Optical Management solution specifically designed for optometrists and ophthalmologists helping redefine operational excellence in eye care practices.

  

Today, our global team of more than 300 professionals operates across the United States and India. Our product ecosystem includes:

  

* MaximEyes Industry-leading EHR, Practice Management, and Optical Software
* Fast Pay Health Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Billing Services
* EVAA AI-powered workflow automation and intelligence platform

  

We are committed to improving patient outcomes, increasing practice efficiency, and driving financial performance for healthcare providers through innovative technology and exceptional service.

  

Join a company that combines deep healthcare expertise, cutting-edge technology, and a mission-driven culture focused on transforming eye care.

  

To learn more, visit: www.first-insight.com

  

**Job Summary**

  

The Product Manager / Product Owner Billing & Revenue Cycle will own and continuously improve the billing capabilities of MaximEyes, First Insight’s EHR and Practice Management System, while also playing a key product role in EVAA Billing Assistant, the company’s AI- and RPA-powered billing automation platform.The role will have a strong mandate to harness AI and intelligent automation to make billing workflows faster, more accurate, more predictive, and increasingly touchless.

  

This is a highly hands-on product role requiring deep expertise in the U.S. healthcare billing lifecycle, preferably within optometry and ophthalmology. The successful candidate will identify billing product issues, define solutions, write detailed requirements, work closely with engineering and QA, validate fixes, and continuously look for opportunities to use AI, automation, workflow intelligence, and data-driven decisioning to eliminate manual work and improve billing outcomes.

  

The role will also help build EVAA Billing Assistant into a scalable, AI-first automation platform capable of integrating with MaximEyes and other leading eye-care EHR/PMS platforms used in the market. The goal is to automate as much of the end-to-end billing lifecycle as practical while retaining appropriate human oversight for exceptions and high-risk decisions.

  

The ideal candidate combines deep billing subject-matter expertise with EHR/PMS product management, product ownership, healthcare workflow knowledge, and a strong understanding of how AI, RPA, APIs, intelligent agents, and workflow automation can be applied to healthcare billing.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own and maintain the billing product roadmap for MaximEyes and related First Insight products, prioritizing enhancements based on customer impact, revenue impact, operational efficiency, regulatory requirements, strategic importance, and the opportunity to leverage AI and automation to remove repetitive work.

  

* Serve as the primary billing subject-matter expert and product owner for MaximEyes, with deep knowledge of patient registration, insurance, eligibility, benefits, authorization, charge capture, coding, claims, clearinghouse workflows, rejections, denials, corrections, secondary billing, coordination of benefits, payment posting, ERA/EOB, patient responsibility, adjustments, refunds, A/R, aging, follow-up, unused benefits, reconciliation, statements, and reporting.

  

* Investigate complex billing problems, reproduce product defects, determine root cause, and define systemic product solutions rather than one-off workarounds.

  

* Work directly with engineering, QA, AI/ML, and automation teams to define requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, workflow specifications, test scenarios, and release validation for billing functionality, including AI-assisted and automated workflows.

  

* Own the product development of EVAA Billing Assistant, including eligibility verification, benefits verification, unused benefits verification, claim preparation and submission, claim-status checking, rejection handling, claim correction and resubmission, payment posting, ERA/EOB processing, reconciliation, A/R workflows, denials, and automated follow-up, with a focus on maximizing the percentage of these activities that can be intelligently automated.

  

* Determine which billing processes should be automated using AI, intelligent agents, RPA, rules-based automation, APIs, or a combination of technologies. Define where AI can interpret information, make recommendations or decisions, predict outcomes, detect anomalies, and initiate actions, while establishing appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, auditability, and exception-handling processes.

  

* Build a practical AI-first product strategy for billing: identify repetitive, rules-heavy, data-heavy, and exception-driven workflows that can be transformed into intelligent agents and automated processes; define measurable targets for touchless processing, accuracy, cycle time, and revenue impact; and continuously learn from production data to improve automation.

  

* Work with engineering, AI/ML, and integration teams to design EVAA integrations across MaximEyes, RevolutionEHR, Compulink, OfficeMate, Eyefinity, ModMed, Acuity Logic, and other relevant EHR/PMS platforms, using APIs, automation, AI agents, and other integration methods wherever practical.

  

* Understand how billing data flows between EHR/PMS systems, clearinghouses, payers, RCM platforms, payment systems,…

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* Experience building products for emerging markets, next billion users, or optimizing app performance for memory-constrained/low-end Android devices.
* Experience launching mobile consumer products at scale with a focus on product growth, user funnels or acquisition.
* Experience with growth product management, consumer mobile apps, referral ingress, push notification systems, or onboarding conversion.
* Understanding of mobile app architecture, client-server latency optimization, Operating System (OS) permissions (e.g., location/notifications), and API/SDK integrations.

**About the job**
-----------------

Geo's mission is to help people explore and navigate the real world wherever they are. We want to make real-world exploration and navigation seamless, intelligent, and universally accessible to all users across every hardware tier and network condition globally. At Google Maps' scale of 2B+ monthly active users, even fractional improvements in funnel conversion, latency, or feature discoverability generate massive, world-scale impact.

As a Product Manager, you will help drive Maps' reach towards 3B monthly active users (MAUs). You will join the International Growth team, with a focus on growing Android Maps (aka aGMM) Reach by creating new and improving existing acquisition and re-activation flywheels. You will drive sustainable, high-velocity user growth and engagement across top Android growth markets (including US, India, Indonesia, Brazil, Vietnam etc) while systematically eliminating friction in the user journey. The team operates at the intersection of product intuition, deep data analytics, and rigorous experimentation.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the multi-quarter strategy and tactical execution plan for global Android Google Mobile Maps (aGMM) MAU growth, daily visits, and users on Google Maps.
* Conduct funnel analyses to pinpoint drop-offs, churn drivers, and user cohorts.
* Design, launch, and analyze high-velocity A/B tests and causal holdback experiments to validate product hypotheses.
* Partner with engineering to streamline app startup latency, payload footprints, and first-interaction times on entry-tier devices.
* Partner closely with dedicated Engineering teams, Data Science/Analytics, UX Design, Research, Legal, and Product Marketing across geographies.

If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

You will define and deliver competitive service offerings by deeply understanding customer needs through collaboration with sales, marketing, and engineering. Your role is crucial in creating marketing materials and evangelizing services to enhance the customer product experience. jobs.title: Product Manager (RASP)
jobs.description:
**About Bureau**

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

**Why Bureau?**

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

**About the Role: Product Manager - RASP**

You will own Bureau RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection). It is a rare chance to take a category-defining security product from launch to scale.

* Sophisticated mobile fraud now executes inside the app itself. Bureau RASP answers with a four-layer Zero Trust framework embedded in the customer's app:
* Application integrity: code obfuscation, anti-tampering and anti-debugging, powered by XVM, our proprietary virtualization engine.
* Runtime and environment: detection of root, jailbreak, emulators, cloned apps, hooking and overlay attacks.
* Network and data channel: protection against MITM, packet sniffing, geo spoofing and VPN or proxy bypass.
* Visibility and policy: monitor, warn or block per threat from a dashboard, with immutable audit logs.

It is built at the OS level, goes live in minutes with no code changes, and feeds runtime signals into Bureau's Graph Identity Network. You will decide where it goes next.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Own the RASP vision, strategy and roadmap across Android and iOS.
* Track the mobile threat landscape and turn new attack patterns into shipped protections.
* Partner with security, SDK and platform engineers to deliver detections that are accurate, hard to bypass and light on app performance.
* Shape the customer experience: zero-code onboarding, the policy engine, alerts and audit reporting.
* Connect RASP signals with Device Intelligence, Behavioural Biometrics and the Graph Identity Network to create value no standalone RASP can match.
* Work with sales, solutions and marketing on positioning, pricing, demos and competitive wins.
* Spend time with CISOs, fraud heads and app teams at banks, fintechs and e-commerce firms to learn what they need.
* Define success metrics such as adoption, detection efficacy, false positives and integration time, and report on them.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must have**

* 4-6 years in product management, with at least 2 years on a B2B security, fraud or mobile SDK product.
* Working knowledge of mobile app security: Android and iOS internals, reverse engineering, rooting, hooking and tampering.
* Comfort going deep with engineers on technical trade-offs, and going wide with customers on business outcomes.
* A record of taking a product from early release to enterprise adoption.
* Clear writing and sharp prioritisation.

**Good to have**

* Experience with RASP, app shielding, device fingerprinting or mobile threat defence.
* Exposure to BFSI or fintech customers and regulatory expectations for app security.
* An engineering or security research background.

**Our Culture**

* We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

**Compensation**

* Competitive salary + potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager I who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 3+ yrs with at least 1+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).
* Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking.
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.

Founded by Sharan Hegde and Raghav Gupta, 1% Club was built on a core belief: financial literacy is the first step to financial independence. Financial Education

Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**What We Need**

* Data-native PM — you think in funnels, cohorts, and experiments before PRDs. You write SQL, build dashboards, and catch insights nobody asked you to find.
* Hands-on with AI agents — you've actually built something with LLMs, not just read about them. Prompt engineering is table stakes.
* Entrepreneur DNA — you've tried building something of your own (a startup, a side project, a 0→1 product) or you're a seasoned Growth PM who's operated across the full acquisition-to-revenue loop.
* Business-grade judgment — you hold your own in revenue conversations, understand unit economics, and translate growth levers into P&L impact.

**This is not a feature PM role.**
There's no stable roadmap someone hands you. You define problems, find levers, ship fast, and measure what matters.
  
  
**What You'll Do -**

* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* You are obsessed with users but grounded in business and data.
* You have 6+ years of experience in product management with at least 2 years focused on growth or PLG initiatives.
* You're hands-on, hungry, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
* You have a strong command over product analytics and experimentation frameworks.
* You understand technology deeply enough to work well with engineers, but your core superpower is thinking from a customer-first and business-first lens.
* You think in systems, love solving root problems, and approach prioritization through impact and effort.
* You’re structured in thinking, biased for action, and love taking ownership end-to-end.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Sabre Payments
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to join our global Sabre Payments team, where innovation knows no borders. The Sabre Payments Product team is dedicated to modernizing how the global travel ecosystem buys, sells and settles transactions by building enterprise-grade, high-availability payment orchestration platforms. As Principal Product Manager, you will lead the strategic vision, architecture and execution of Sabre’s next-generation Travel Payout Platform, enabling airlines, agencies, hotels and travel operators to disburse funds globally.
  
  
This role directly aligns with Sabre’s core business strategy to expand beyond distribution and retail into high-margin fintech infrastructure and automated B2B financial workflows. By bridging legacy travel bookings with modern multi-rail payment networks, you will drive new revenue streams and establish Sabre as the definitive B2B payout hub for the travel industry. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.
  
  
As Principal Product Manager, you will lead platform execution and establish high-throughput financial infrastructure across global markets. You will bridge complex technical architecture with high-stakes commercial strategy, collaborating with engineering, external financial partners and enterprise clients. This role requires deep domain mastery in fintech and B2B payout orchestration, clear commercial acumen and the confidence to challenge legacy settlement processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Establish the multi-year product vision, strategic positioning and financial business cases for the platform, taking end-to-end accountability for gross disbursement volume (GDV), platform take rates and product ROI.
* Lead high-stakes product and technical evaluations with external payment partners, including virtual card issuing platforms, premium regional issuers and cross-border bank networks, to structure optimal rebate-sharing models, SLA guarantees and integration frameworks.
* Drive the end-to-end product development lifecycle from initial MVP scoping through enterprise rollout, defining high-value feature prioritization, RESTful API specifications and architectural requirements alongside engineering leadership.
* Serve as the authoritative product voice across sales leadership, legal, risk and compliance teams to ensure alignment on regulatory standards (KYB/AML, PCI-DSS), commercial strategy and enterprise customer readiness.
* Define North Star product performance indicators, build telemetry frameworks for transaction routing and reconciliation, and establish operating models with dedicated customer support and exception-handling teams.
* Use generative artificial intelligence, automation and agentic flows to optimize platform routing intelligence, automate product planning and accelerate feature delivery.

**What You'll Bring**
Required qualifications
  
  

* Minimum 10 years of senior product management experience owning, scaling and managing complex multi-sided enterprise technology platforms, RESTful API products or high-throughput transaction engines from concept through commercial rollout.
* Strategic platform and API-first product ownership experience, with demonstrated expertise in defining technical platform architectures, platform routing logic and developer-centric capabilities.
* Commercial and data-driven business acumen, including the proven capability to define product unit economics, build financial business cases, analyze complex operational data and structure strategic commercial relationships.
* Executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with a history of influencing cross-functional engineering, legal, risk and commercial teams, as well as presenting product vision to internal leadership and enterprise client executives.
* Practical experience applying generative artificial intelligence, automation or analytics tools to enhance platform capabilities and team productivity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in commercial fintech, B2B payment orchestration, card issuing, merchant acquiring or travel technology systems (e.g., GDS, booking engines, settlement networks).

**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong data-driven mindset with experience defining and optimizing multi-objective platform metrics (safety versus speed versus operational cost).
* Technical familiarity with LLM security evaluation, AI threat models (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), or static/dynamic code analysis tools.

**About The Job**
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
  
  
The App and Ecosystem Trust (AET) team ensures safe, secure, and trustworthy experiences across our global app ecosystem. Mokka is the core review engine that processes every app submission, update, and runtime signal to protect billions of users from security vulnerabilities, policy violations, and malicious behavior.
  
  
As the Product Manager for Mokka in Bengaluru, you will take the lead on driving the overall strategy and tactical execution of our next-generation review infrastructure. Your core mission is to bridge advanced ML-driven detection capabilities with developer velocity, ensuring our entire ecosystem remains secure without unnecessary friction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define the multi-year product roadmap for Mokka, the app safety review platform, to scale under submission volume increases driven by AI-assisted code generation (vibe coding).
* Balance friction-free onboarding for legitimate developers with verification checks for high-risk or automated app factories.
* Partner closely with ML Research, Security Engineering, Policy Operations, and Developer Relations across global sites, driving alignment across vertical AET teams to ensure Mokka functions seamlessly as a unified trust platform.
* Architect automated static, dynamic, and LLM-assisted review pipelines that intercept modern security threats before apps reach production, designing defenses against emerging AI vulnerabilities, including malicious model weights, indirect prompt injection vectors, agentic permission escalation, and generative privacy leaks.
* Partner with teams to design intelligent human-in-the-loop review interfaces, leveraging generative AI assistants to speed up analyst workflows and reduce manual cognitive load.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Quality System Owner and AI Compliance
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose -**

  

To lead the ideation, development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI (GenAI) technologies within the global Quality organization. This role ensures the compliant, harmonized, and value-driven use of AI and associated automation across GxP-regulated processes by acting as both a program lead and operational enabler. This role directs and manages the translation of business requirements into detailed user requirements and plays and active in the technical development, data pipeline, software documentation, validation efforts, user training, deployment and lifecycle management. This position supports users in the adoption of AI tools and ensures that all AI-enabled applications supported in this role meet regulatory, data integrity, and business performance standards. Own the procedures and documents to ensure compliance to regulations and acceptable deployment GxP AI applications for GSC to include audit support, QMS integration, connection to other applicable applications and use of Enterprise AI mass deployed tools such as GiGi and MSFT CoPilot. The role also serves as a key interface between Quality, TECH, Responsible AI other GSC BUs, and other functions to ensure that AI solutions are scalable, auditable, and continuously improved.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities -**

  

**AI System Development, Deployment and Lifecycle Management**

* Define and continuously refine the roadmap for the supported system(s) and AI applications to include a product backlog of enhancements and updates.
* Working with process owners, all relevant stakeholders and Tech to translate the business-identified use cases into business requirements for cost and timing estimates and ultimately into user requirements.
* Drive delivery of AI prototypes to prove concepts and demonstrate value. Lead further refinement of the AI tool to deliver a minimum viable product (MVP) and iterations per the aligned to roadmap while realizing direct efficiency or effort reduction for the business.
* Lead the implementation of AI use cases across Quality domains, ensuring measurable impact on compliance, efficiency, adoption and user experience.
* Serve as business representative for the technology aspects of AI-enabled Quality processes, ensuring compliant and harmonized use of GxP AI applications across GSC.
  

  

**Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure AI applications comply with GxP and data integrity requirements by following process and procedures to include but are not limited to Responsible AI, DTMS (Digital & Tech Management System), Computer Software Validation, AI risk and control measures.
* Collaborate with QMS and validation teams to ensure AI tools are appropriately documented, validated, and auditable.
* Ensure the AI risk and control measures are documented and include as part of the software development and lifecycle process to include risk mitigation, AI guardrails and required data inputs for on-going AI model oversight.
  

  

**Operational Support & Change Enablement**

* Support Quality teams during audits and inspections by preparing AI-related documentation, performance monitoring outputs, and FAQ documentation.
* Train and onboard new users, interns, and site Quality Experts on the AI tools and processes supported by this role.
* Generate appropriate audit preparation documentation that could include an audit storyboard, AI compliance information, frequently asked questions, etc.
  

  

**Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor KPIs related to AI adoption, accuracy, and compliance. Analyze trends and provide guidance to sites on reducing errors and achieving targets.
* Lead forums and working groups for supported systems to drive AI process improvements, share best practices, and harmonize implementation across sites.
* Evaluate change requests and product backlog for supported AI systems and assess their impact on business processes, compliance, and user experience.
* Create and define a plan for data based process oversight after the implementation of AI automation.
  

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Interface with Responsible AI, Digital & Tech, Business, Regulatory, Data Governance, and Quality Systems & Standards to ensure AI initiatives are integrated and compliant.
* Represent Quality in steering committees, vendor demos, and industry forums to benchmark and shape best practices.
* Support the integration of AI into broader strategic initiatives such as Smart Manufacturing 2030, Virtual Inspector, and Quality Plan/Quality Improvement Plan.
  

  

**Knowledge Management & Community Building**

* Maintain a knowledge base of AI after action reviews, best practices and learnings to benchmark and improve AI implementation and lifecycle management.
* Ensure training materials and documentation are up to date and accessible in centralized repositories.
  

  

**Required Qualification & Skills-**

  

* 15+ years of profession experience with Bachelor's/ Master's degree or equivalent in experience. Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or related discipline
* Experience with demonstrated experience in delivering Digital Transformation, AI/ML, scaled automation, technology solutions or similar roles within life sciences regulated industries. Proven leadership in deploying Innovative solutions in highly regulated GxP environments.
* Strong experience in technical or engineering role.
* Experience working in agile teams that drive innovation and simplification by providing enterprise wide standardized solutions.
* Ability to work across an enterprise to influence business outcomes as quickly as possible.
* Deep understanding of Digital, Data, Analytics AI/ML, GenAI, and their application in Quality systems.
* Strong knowledge of validation, compliance, and risk management in pharmaceutical settings.
* Strong knowledge of business case creation and realization of value from digital project implementation.

**The Role**

As Solution Architect, you will own the technical architecture of the VisioGen platform and build it alongside the team. You will design the system, contribute production code, set engineering standards, and help grow the team that scales the platform across clinics worldwide.

The role acts as a bridge between business teams, product teams, engineering, IT, customer success, and external clinic partners, turning business needs into practical, secure, and scalable technology solutions.

This is a hands-on architecture role. A significant part of your time will go into design, coding, code reviews, and proofs of concept, alongside technical leadership. It suits someone who enjoys building & solving problems directly, rather than a primarily presales, delivery-management, or support profile.

  

**What You Will Do**

* Establish an efficient commercial release process that meets ZEISS's software delivery gating requirements.

* Own CI/CD and environment strategy using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including versioning, feature flags, and safe rollout and rollback.

* Define release dependencies, branching, and merge strategy.

* Collaborate with ZEISS Central IT to align architecture approaches and partner solutions with ZEISS-approved, compliant setups.

  

**6. Security & Compliance by Design**

* Build **HIPAA-aligned** data flows (with GDPR and global readiness as applicable): PHI handling, encryption, access control, data retention, and audit logging.

* Represent the architecture in ZEISS IT, InfoSec, and compliance reviews, and produce the data-flow and threat-model documents they require.

  

**7. Build and Mentor the Team**

* Partner with product to judge feasibility, estimate work, and shape the roadmap.

**8. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

**Job Description**
About the role
  
  
You will own the Payments product end to end for our Fund Services. As the voice of the customer, you will turn client needs, business priorities, and regulatory intent into a prioritised backlog and high-quality delivery, from concept to launch.
  
  
You will be the single point of ownership across Product, Engineering, Business Analysis, Testing, Application Support, and global Operations. This is a hands-on role in a regulated environment, balancing functional, resiliency, security, and regulatory needs, with controls and governance central to every change.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Product ownership and delivery
  
  

* Own the Payments vision, roadmap, and prioritised backlog, and write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria.
* Run sprint planning, refinement, reviews, UAT, and business sign off, and make tradeoffs across scope, quality, timelines, and feasibility.
* Track performance and adoption post release through metrics such as payment success rates, volumes, and processing times.
* Support modernisation and simplification of legacy payment capabilities, improving resiliency and availability with the specialist team.

AI enabled payments
  
  

* Own and expand AI assisted features, building on the live AI assisted transaction review, keeping recommendations advisory and the final decision with the approver.
* Embed AI within existing approval workflows so controls hold, sensitive data is never exposed to the AI service, and AI processing stays auditable.
* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Compliance, using AI assisted prototyping to test ideas before committing engineering capacity.

Payment functionality and workflows
  
  

* Own the functional behaviour and user experience for payments, including approval, maker checker, and signer workflows.
* Partner with the dedicated bank integrations and formats specialists, who own rails, message formats, and connectivity, translating their input into product requirements.

Client onboarding and commercial input
  
  

* Lead payments onboarding and enhancements for existing, new, and prospective clients, including go lives and hypercare.
* Elicit explicit and implicit needs, benchmark against market and competitors, and support presales and RFP responses.

Governance, controls, and compliance
  
  

* Own role creation, role catalogue, and the role inventory for access provisioning.
* Partner with Internal Control and local IT on access remediation, including restricted access and various regulatory requirements for confidential client data.
* Ensure nonfunctional requirements, SLAs, and control obligations are captured within delivery.

Dependency, risk, and production support
  
  

* Manage cross team dependencies and delivery risks early and act as product point of contact for production issues through root cause and fix.
* Apply strong judgement on when to act, align, or escalate, particularly where client harm or regulatory risk may arise.

Team management and mentoring
  
  

* People manage junior Business Analysts, including day-to-day work, training, and career development.
* Act as the recognised subject matter expert for the Payments product and coach the team on agile practice and product thinking.

What you will bring
  
  
**Required**

* Overall 10 or more years in product ownership or business analysis, with at least three documented years as Product Owner into payments, banking, or fund services technology.
* Functional knowledge of payment flows including IAT, FX, and batch and bulk payments. Deep rails and message format expertise is not required, as a specialist team holds it.
* Proven agile backlog management, writing precise user stories, BRDs, and acceptance criteria, including for AI driven functionality.
* Experience delivering in a regulated, controls driven environment, with a grasp of RBAC, segregation of duties, client protection, and audit remediation.
* Strong stakeholder management, able to challenge, influence, and drive decisions across business, architecture, and engineering in a matrix organisation.
* Commercial acumen, data driven decisions, and clear communication across senior and client facing audiences and time zones.
* Working proficiency with agile tooling such as JIRA and Confluence, and with Excel and PowerPoint.

**Preferred**

* Client facing and commercially minded, comfortable running demos and shaping product direction from client problems.
* Working knowledge of Generative and Agentic AI, rapid prototyping, and AI governance, applied within proper controls.
* Experience with cross-regional payments modernisation and regulatory change, for example SEPA Instant or Verification of Payee.
* Product certification such as CSPO, PSPO, or SAFe POPM, and a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. An MBA is a plus.

How you will work
  
  
You will move from client problem to discovery, to AI assisted prototype, to validation, and then to engineering rollout, while protecting business as usual. Controls, security, testing, and governance stay central to every payments change.

User adoption and satisfaction with reporting solutions. Maintain strong data, reporting and change controls across the Business Insights book of work. Engage with Line Operations staff and escalate issues promptly and appropriately. Remain fully aware of the control framework and take a proactive approach to reducing operational risk.

---------------

Working as part of the Lab Automation, LIMS & Data Management team, the role collaborates with laboratory users, digital teams, data specialists, suppliers and project teams to gather requirements, support implementation activities and help ensure laboratory data is captured, managed and accessible throughout its lifecycle. The role contributes to the successful deployment of LIMS, data management and integration solutions that improve laboratory efficiency, compliance, data quality and digital enablement.

------------------------

* Facilitate requirements gathering activities through workshops, interviews, process mapping and stakeholder engagement.
* Engage with scientists, laboratory personnel and subject matter experts (SMEs) to understand current laboratory workflows, sample management processes, data requirements and operational challenges.

* Collaborate with Data Management specialists, Digital Security, Digital Delivery, system integrators and vendors to support integrated laboratory workflows and data flows.
* Participate in system configuration, testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), deployment and operational handover activities.
* Support user training, adoption and change management activities to drive successful implementation and sustainable business outcomes.
* Assist with testing and validation of data interfaces and workflows to ensure information is transferred accurately and reliably between systems.
* Support identification and development of AI, analytics and reporting use cases through improved access to structured laboratory data.
* Contribute to development and implementation of laboratory data management approaches, standards and best practices across Downstream R&D.
* Support implementation of data governance, taxonomy and master data management activities to improve data quality, integrity, traceability and compliance.

* Support integration between LIMS, laboratory instruments, automation platforms, ELN, ERP and other enterprise systems.
* Contribute to reporting, analytics and data improvement initiatives that support digital laboratory transformation and AI readiness.

------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree as a minimum in science, engineering or a related discipline.
* 3-5 years of relevant experience in laboratory operations, laboratory informatics, business analysis, digital transformation or data management environments.
* Experience gathering, documenting and handling business and user requirements.
* Experience supporting technology deployment, process improvement or digital transformation projects.
* Strong analytical, process mapping and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with multidisciplinary stakeholders and facilitating discussions across technical and business teams.
* Understanding of data quality, data governance and master data concepts.
* Experience working with scientific, laboratory or enterprise data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Desirable Education & Experience**
------------------------------------

* Understanding of laboratory workflows, sample lifecycle management, testing processes and scientific data management.
* Knowledge of laboratory automation, robotics, equipment integration or orchestration platforms.

jobs.title: Project Warranty Data Analyst [RS eLOCO]
jobs.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time Project Warranty Data Analyst in Bengaluru we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your data analysis expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, detail-oriented, and innovative teammates.

You'll play a key role in ensuring the success of our warranty and performance improvement (PI) activities for metro and locomotive rolling stock. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as engineering, operations, and customer service), analyze technical and financial data, and manage warranty-related information to support decision-making, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of data management and technical analysis, but also provide insights to improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

We’ll look to you for:

* Managing warranty and performance improvement data for metro and locomotive rolling stock
* Conducting technical and financial data analysis to identify trends and actionable insights
* Utilizing digital tools such as GSI, Microsoft Office Suite, and SAP for data handling and reporting
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support warranty activities
* Contributing to the development of efficient processes and tools for data management
* Providing clear and professional communication to internal and external stakeholders
  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Degree in engineering, data analytics, or a related field
* 1-3 years of experience in metro or locomotive rolling stock warranty or performance improvement activities
* Proficiency in data management and analysis
* Familiarity with digital tools such as GSI, Microsoft Office Suite, and SAP
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including English proficiency
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset
  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with cutting-edge digital tools for data management and analysis
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and supportive colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility
* Utilise our inclusive and dynamic working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
* Progress towards senior roles in data analysis, warranty management, or other areas
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

**Job Segment:** Database, ERP, SAP, Technology

Your expertise in payer operations, regulatory compliance (HIPAA, CMS), and value-based care models will drive the design and implementation of impactful solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivering measurable value to our clients. You'll mentor junior analysts and champion best practices within the team.
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**
As a Senior Business Analyst specializing in the Healthcare & Life Sciences (HCLS) domain, with a focus on Payer operations, you will play a pivotal role in understanding, analyzing, and translating complex business needs into actionable technology solutions. You will act as a key liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, and project management, ensuring successful delivery of initiatives that enhance efficiency, compliance, and member/provider experience within the payer landscape.
  
  
**Requirements Elicitation & Analysis**

* Lead and facilitate workshops, interviews, and brainstorming sessions with diverse stakeholders (e.g., claims, enrollment, provider relations, finance, compliance) to elicit, document, and prioritize detailed business requirements.
* Analyze current state processes, identify pain points, and propose future state solutions, leveraging deep understanding of payer operations (e.g., claims adjudication, benefit configuration, premium billing, member services, provider contracting).
* Translate high-level business needs into clear, concise, and unambiguous functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, use cases, and process flows (BPMN).

**Solution Design & Strategy**

* Collaborate with architects, developers, and product owners to design and validate technical solutions that meet business requirements and align with organizational strategy and industry best practices.
* Evaluate potential solutions, including commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) products and custom development, performing gap analyses and recommending optimal approaches.
* Contribute to the development of business cases, ROI analyses, and project roadmaps.

**Payer Domain Expertise & Compliance**

* Apply in-depth knowledge of healthcare payer regulations (e.g., HIPAA, ACA, CMS guidelines, state mandates) to ensure all solutions are compliant and mitigate risks.
* Understand and articulate the impact of industry trends such as value-based care, interoperability (FHIR), digital transformation, and consumerism on payer operations.
* Provide subject matter expertise on various payer lines of business (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Exchange).

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, managing expectations, resolving conflicts, and ensuring alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and business implications to technical teams effectively.
* Prepare and deliver presentations, reports, and documentation to various levels of management and project teams.

**Testing & Quality Assurance Support**

* Define acceptance criteria and support the creation of test plans and test cases.
* Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and defect triage, ensuring solutions meet business requirements and quality standards.

**Documentation & Artifacts**

* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), process maps, data flow diagrams, and user manuals.

**Must Have Skills**

* Requirements Expertise: Elicitation, documentation, prioritization (JIRA, Azure DevOps).
* Process Modeling: Current/future state, optimization (BPMN, Visio).
* Data Analysis: Advanced SQL, Data Visualization (Tableau, Power BI).
* Payer Domain Knowledge: Claims, enrollment, provider networks, benefits.
* Regulatory Compliance: HIPAA, ACA, CMS, X12 EDI, FHIR.
* Technical Acumen: API concepts, system integration, database fundamentals.
* Testing Support: Acceptance criteria, UAT.
* Documentation: Comprehensive project artifacts.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
